name: Learning Something New
description: Eight light prompts about picking up a new skill or idea.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight light prompts about learning something new, with optional notes, on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow whichever prompt you like.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and see where your mind goes.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
tips: A note can be a single word. Clear your notes any time.
